text:
tyler.chen: Heads-up — thinking about adding sampled telemetry for service-account tokens so the Console can show per-SA latency/cost trends without storing full tokens. Thoughts?

anita.rao: +1 on visibility. main constraint is privacy — we must never persist raw tokens or anything that can be reversed to a token.

raj.patel: How big are we talking volume-wise? Even 0.1% can blow up for our busiest orgs. We need per-org caps.

tyler.chen: Quick estimate: a heavy tenant ~2M requests/day. 0.1% => 2k events/day. With per-org caps + burst window we can keep pipeline bounded.

keisha: Important: sampled events must be telemetry-only and not affect billing/quota enforcement. Put them behind a separate ingestion path.

anita.rao: Security suggestion: derive a non-reversible SA identifier via HMAC(sa_id, KMS_salt) and store only that. No token prefixes, no raw ids.

security: sec-bot: Please add a short threat model in the RFC. We need to review HMAC key rotation, restricted access to telemetry, and audit logging before sign-off.

tyler.chen: Proto config snippet: ```sampling: { global_rate: 0.001, per_org_max_per_hour: 1000, per_sa_max_per_hour: 200, seed_store: "redis://sampler" }```

raj.patel: For the event shape, keep it tiny: `sa_hmac`, `model`, `region`, `latency_ms`, `token_count`, `timestamp`. Absolutely NO prompt/text fields.

keisha: Console UX idea: label these as "sampled estimates" with confidence interval, and add an org-level opt-out toggle (org-admin controls sampling opt-out).

anita.rao: Rollout plan: server-side canary (staging -> 5% clusters -> 25% -> global) and verify that sampled events never leak user identifiers. Retention: 30 days default, configurable by enterprise.

tyler.chen: Question for the team: server-side sampling vs SDK opt-in? Server-side is faster for shipping but SDKs can reduce upstream noise and offer opt-out at client level.

raj.patel: I prefer server-side to avoid waiting on SDK releases. We can add SDK sampling later as an opt-in to reduce jobs that hit the sampler for customers who opt-in to client-side sampling.

keisha: Add feature-flag for the rollout: `flag/sa-sampling-v1`. Start with non-prod orgs and internal accounts first. Also instrument sampling counts in the Console so we can see signal volume.

security: sec-bot: Holding sign-off until RFC includes (1) KMS key rotation plan, (2) telemetry access RBAC, (3) example queries to ensure no join will reconstruct tokens.

tyler.chen: Action items: (1) I’ll open an RFC with config, event shape, and threat model (2) Raj will size ingestion + storage + per-org caps (3) Keisha will mock Console UI and toggles.

anita.rao: I’ll own the security review and sign-off once RFC is up.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: created feature flag `flag/sa-sampling-v1` in staging.

tyler.chen: Thanks everyone — I’ll post the RFC link here once created.
